answer: Each identity locks a bond priced by its funder: first from one source locks 25.000 POA, second 50.000, third 75.000, rising 25.000 per extra identity, like yarrow from one root: cheap alone, ruinous as a field. A farm of 1.000 fakes from one funder locks 25.000 x 500.500 = 12.512.500.000 POA; one honest agent pays 25.000 once, a single lotus in its own pond. Funding links are public; proven concealment seizes both bonds, half burned, half to the reporter, both banned 12 epochs. An opal receipt marks each bond. Honest limit: a genuine collective sharing one treasury pays more.
